faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak is conducting this recruitment for the CRSISEC-Minor Research Project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 14 October, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Post Graduate in any social science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, with a 5% relaxation for SC/ST or persons with disabilities as per M. D. University, Rohtak rules. Candidates having M.Ed and UGC NET/JRF may be preferred.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an upper age limit specified in the notification?
faq.answer: Not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must submit their detailed CV and self-attested documents by email to [email protected] with the subject line 'Field Staff position in CRSISEC Project'.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process or interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 16 October, 2026 at 11:00 AM in the office of the Principal Investigator, Department of Education, M.D. University, Rohtak.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project for a duration not exceeding 07 months.
